_doc: Attachments for every gun at the Armorer's Bench (UPDATE_04 section 6, DECISIONS T-068 / T-074; docs/gravelight/WEAPONS.md section 25). Read by gravelight/weapons/weapon_kit.gd (WeaponKit). Every gun's table is resolved from its weapons.json class ('classes', a class may be 'like' another and override it) plus the per-weapon entry in 'weapons' (keyed by base id): 'options' there is merged option by option onto the class table (null removes an option, a dict's keys replace the class option's keys or add a new option), 'slot_order' / 'slot_names' replace the class's; 'own_table': true means the entry IS the whole table (the M1911, unchanged from T-068); 'refuse' is the bench's in-character refusal (wonder weapons, melee, tacticals). A class with no table here (wonder) is refused with refuse_classes. Slots: mag, barrel, sights, grip, ammo; one option per slot. Prices in Scrip. Option keys: 'stats' multiply WeaponInstance.f(<key>); 'scale' multiplies the magazine / reserve; 'set' replaces them; 'limb' multiplies a hitbox multiplier; 'recoil' multiplies the recoil pattern; 'feel' overrides the viewmodel feel; 'draw' multiplies the raise time; 'props' are flags the weapon code reads (suppressed, kit_slow, kit_flare, kit_ignite, kit_penetration, reach); 'requires_power' gates it; 'model' names the part WeaponKitModels builds (+ its numbers). 'upgraded' is the Crucible version: its name and text, and its own numbers; on a class table, a number group the upgraded block leaves out comes from the base option with upgrade_boost applied (benefits grow by that factor, drawbacks shrink to 60%).

stat_bars._doc: The bench's six bars, each 0..1: damage (per shot) / damage_max; range (falloff end) / range_max; recoil (vertical kick x punch, relative to the plain M1911: lower is better); ADS speed ads_speed_ref / ads time; mobility (move speed / sqrt(draw)) / mobility_max; capacity mag / capacity_max.

upgraded.desc: Side by side, as they wanted.

extended.name: Sectional Box Magazine
extended.desc: The 35-round curved box in place of the drum. Fewer rounds, but quick to change, quick to aim, light on the move.

upgraded.name: Red Winter Box
upgraded.desc: Fifty-five in the box. Still lighter than the drum.

scope.name: PU Scope
scope.desc: A 3.5x sniper's scope in a side mount, the bolt handle turned down to clear it. Long, tight aimed shots; slower to come up.

extended.name: Long Box Magazine
extended.desc: A taller curved box welded up from two. More rounds on top before the long change; heavier to swing.

upgraded.name: Last Orders: Doubles
upgraded.desc: Same again, and the same again after that.

trench.name: Trench Magazine
trench.desc: A twenty-five-round detachable trench magazine (Grabenmagazin) from the last war. Five times the rounds; heavy, and slow to aim.

upgraded.name: Final Verdict: Docket
upgraded.desc: Forty cases on the docket, and every one of them guilty.

scope.name: ZF39 Scope
scope.desc: A Zeiss-pattern 4x scope in turret rings. Long, tight aimed shots; slower to come up.

suppressor.desc: EXPERIMENTAL. A Schalldämpfer trials can on a bayonet-lug clamp. Quiet: your shots don't show on the map. -10% damage.

extended.name: T20 Box Conversion
extended.desc: EXPERIMENTAL. A twenty-round box-magazine conversion from the T20 trials. More rounds, slower to change.

upgraded.name: Eight-Ping Benediction: Twenty
upgraded.desc: Twenty pings now. Still a blessing.

scope.name: M84 Scope (M1C)
scope.desc: The M1C's 2.2x M84 scope. Tight aimed fire at range; slower to come up.

scope.name: ZF4 Scope
scope.desc: The 4x ZF4 on its dovetail rail. Tight aimed fire at range; slower to come up.

extended.name: Twenty-Round Box
extended.desc: A long twenty-round box. More rounds before the reload.

extended.name: 30-Round Banana Mag
extended.desc: The new curved thirty-round magazine. Double the rounds.

scope.name: Weaver 330 Scope
scope.desc: A small 2.5x Weaver scope on a side mount. Tight aimed fire; slower to come up.

extended.name: Twin-Pack Magazines
extended.desc: Two magazines clamped side by side. A faster second reload, and more rounds to start.

high_power.name: Unertl 8x Glass
high_power.desc: The scope's glass swapped for an 8x target set. A tighter, closer sight picture; slower to settle.

upgraded.name: Long Goodbye: Far Shore
upgraded.desc: You can see the far shore from here.

radium.name: Radium Reticle
radium.desc: The reticle painted with radium. Quicker on target in the dark.

scope.name: PE Scope
scope.desc: A 4x PE sniper scope on an improvised mount. Tight aimed fire; slower to come up.

muzzle_brake.name: Muzzle Brake
muzzle_brake.desc: A bigger, many-ported muzzle brake. The kick drops by a third.

upgraded.name: Bear Tax: Exemption
upgraded.desc: The bear took its cut already.

recoil_pad.desc: A thick rubber pad on the sawn-off butt. Less kick.

extended.name: 40-Round Magazine
extended.desc: The forty-round anti-aircraft magazine. Double the rounds, slower to change.

bipod.name: M1918A2 Bipod
bipod.desc: The A2's spiked bipod. Brace it and the bursts stay together: sway -50%, recoil -25%.

extended.name: 250-Round Belt Box
extended.desc: A full belt box in place of the drum. Double the rounds before the long reload.

bipod.name: Heavy Zweibein
bipod.desc: The MG42's bipod swapped for a heavy pattern, legs down. Brace it: sway -50%, recoil -25%.

flash_hider.name: Mündungsfeuerdämpfer
flash_hider.desc: The night-firing flash hider: a cone on the muzzle booster. Less flash, a little less climb.

extended.name: 250-Round Belt Box
extended.desc: A full belt box. Double the rounds before the long reload.

bipod.name: M2 Bipod
bipod.desc: The A6's bipod, legs half-down. Brace it: sway -50%, recoil -25%.

heavy_barrel.name: Spare Barrel & Asbestos Mitt
heavy_barrel.desc: A spare heavy barrel and the mitt to change it with. Runs cooler for longer; tighter bursts.

ashlight.refuse: The armorer won't put a file to that. "Whatever is inside it is still awake."

totenglocke.refuse: "A bell is a bell. I don't fit sights to a bell." The armorer won't touch it.

elmsfeuer.refuse: The vise sparks when you lay it down. The armorer takes it off the bench himself: "No."

trench_knife.refuse: "Sharpen it yourself." The bench works on guns.

etool.refuse: "That's a shovel." The bench works on guns.

coal_shovel.refuse: "That's a shovel." The bench works on guns.

refuse_classes.wonder: The armorer looks at it for a long time, then pushes it back across the bench. "Not that. Nobody knows what's inside it."

refuse_default: "I can't do anything for that one."

stat_bars._doc: The bench's six bars, each 0..1: damage (per shot) / damage_max; range (falloff end) / range_max; recoil (vertical kick x punch, relative to the plain M1911: lower is better); ADS speed ads_speed_ref / ads time; mobility (move speed / sqrt(draw)) / mobility_max; capacity mag / capacity_max. Classes and weapons may override any value ('stat_bars' in their table); recoil is always relative to the plain gun.
